_comment: Copy this file to scripts/photos-process-config.json and fill in the paths. Used by strip-bg.py and composite-cards.py.
sourceFolder: G:\My Drive\Live Coverage\Race Brands\Tough Mudder\2026\Athlete Photos Source
transparentFolder: G:\My Drive\Live Coverage\Race Brands\Tough Mudder\2026\Athlete Photos
cardsFolder: G:\My Drive\Live Coverage\Race Brands\Tough Mudder\2026\Athlete Cards
_notes: sourceFolder        — raw athlete photos with backgrounds. Filename must start with bib, e.g. '56.jpg' or '56 Joseph Rucco.jpg'.
transparentFolder   — strip-bg.py writes here. Doubles as the vMix solo-stats source.
backgroundPath      — your step-and-repeat PNG; cover-fit and centred. The provided one already carries the WTM + OCR Report logos.
wtmLogoPath / ocrLogoPath — leave empty if the step-and-repeat already has the logos baked in.
outerFrame          — true draws a 10px rounded TM-orange border 28px from the edge; false leaves the canvas clean to the edges.
bottomBanner        — solid race-name strip at the bottom (orange w/ slight gradient + accent rule).
bottomBannerText    — line wraps automatically; last word becomes line 2.
rembgModel          — 'u2net_human_seg' for people; 'birefnet-portrait' higher quality; 'u2netp' fastest.
